headline: Executive order changes tariffs on low-value packages and goods imported from China, as part of earlier actions tied to synthetic opioids.
what_it_does: This order further amends earlier tariffs placed on goods from China, which were linked to the flow of synthetic opioids such as fentanyl. Based on its title, it changes how those duties apply to low-value imports, such as small packages shipped directly to buyers. No summary was provided, so the exact rates and rules are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People in the US who buy low-cost items shipped from China
who_it_affects.how: They may face new or different import duties on small orders, which could affect prices.

who_it_affects.group: Online sellers and retailers that ship low-value goods from China
who_it_affects.how: Their shipments may be subject to changed tariff rules.
They may need to handle changed duty collection on small packages from China.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 2, 2025; the title does not state when the changes begin.
